discussion.key_messages: - Patchy fog will dissipate this morning across northern Utah valleys and near Evanston, WY. - A cold, Pacific system will impact the region later Monday into Wednesday morning. Accumulating snow will impact most Utah mountain locations as well as the Wasatch Back. Expect the heaviest totals across the upper Cottonwoods and southern Mountains. - Another colder Pacific system will impact the region Thursday into early Saturday. Snow levels will lower to near to below 5000 feet by Saturday morning.

rules_take: Beaver Mountain: the forecasts put 6–21 in. over the next 7 days (middle 13 in.), and they disagree a lot. About 3 in. of that lands in the next 72 hours. The NWS forecasters have 13 in. for the week.
